title: fix(objectql, metadata-protocol)!: by-name doors judge a name's holders over the served set, so a disabled package's item is not a holder (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4A4i75GS3izWa4tjti3Tav)_ Fixes #32183 Clause-②: no (narrowing) — for a name that only disabled packages hold, `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem`, `MetadataFacade.get` / `getEntry` and `SchemaRegistry.getApp` (`@objectstack/objectql`) answer `undefined` where they answered the disabled package's body, and `MetadataFacade.exists` answers false where it answered true. Every by-name door already withheld that body. Every other moved answer widens or names fewer packages: a name one enabled and one disabled package hold is served by the enabled holder where it was refused naming both. Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` already says a disabled module is hidden, and no skill or doc teaches the by-name answer for a name a disabled package holds. **Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (measured). `MetadataFacade` is never constructed in-tree, `SchemaRegistry.getApp` has no in-tree caller, and the one door that reads `resolveItem` (the protocol's by-name read) already withheld a disabled package's body. On showcase (22 packages, 205 package-scoped names), crm (18, 35) and multi-package (16, 27), no name has two holders and no package is disabled at boot. Claim by `domain:server#3`; seat GO with rulings (a)–(c) in claim amendment 6773105294; step-0 readings in 6773035227. Child of epic #31527 (ADR-0150 D3). ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：按名读取包作用域元数据时，「持有者」现在只算正在提供服务的包。已停用包的条目不再算持有者：一个名字由一个启用包和一个停用包同时持有时，由启用包作答，不再 409 列出两者；只有停用包持有的名字等同无人持有（404 或未找到），不再点名停用包。存储引用回填、CLI 存储引用报告、选项列表（picklist）判定这类持久判断仍读全部持有者，所以停用是可逆的，绑定不会跟着停用移动。 - 为什么改：列表读取早已隐藏停用包的条目，按名读取却还把它算作持有者，于是同一个名字在列表里只有一个、按名读却被 409 拒绝，或者拒绝信息点名一个看不见的包（ADR-0150 D3，史诗 #31527）。 - 风险与回滚：多数答案是放宽（409 变 200）。唯一的收窄是进程内库 API：只有停用包持有的名字，`resolveItem`、`MetadataFacade.get` 和 `getApp` 返回 `undefined`，`exists` 返回 false，第一方调用方 0。第一方示例里没有两个包同名、也没有启动即停用的包。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`（`packageScopedHoldersOf` 的 served 过滤与 `picklistReferenceVerdict`），然后 `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`（只有停用包持有的名字仍按停用包的被扣留条目作答，分层视图和 `/published` 不会把它端出来），最后 `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts`（停用持有者的列不改指向）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中 `#32183` 开头的几节逐级钉住。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **The holder set is the served set** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `packageScopedHoldersOf`). A holder whose package is disabled (`isPackageDisabled`, the predicate `listItems` hides by) is left out, except the caller's own holding. `options.includeDisabledPackages: true` (the option name `listItems` already carries) reads every holder. A disable never promotes a dependent's bundle addition to a holder: the addition test still runs over every holder. `resolvePackageScopedName`'s query takes `includeDisabledPackages` and forwards it, and so do the action addressing wrapper and the install door's pending-manifest view. - **Durable judgments read every holder**, so a stored binding never moves with a reversible disable: - the stored-reference backfills: permission sets (`plugin-security`), sharing declarations (`plugin-sharing`), email templates (`plugin-email`) and the activation ledger (`objectql`); - the CLI stored-reference report (`os migrate stored-references`, `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`); - `picklistReferenceVerdict`, which the kernel:ready load audit, the install door and a field's options fold share. A disable never refuses the next boot and never empties a live field's options. - **The security catalog** (`packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts`): - a stored column naming a package that still holds the set but is disabled is not-found, never re-targeted to the enabled holder; - a name only disabled packages hold is not-found, never the metadata service's by-name body; - `holdsPlatformPermissionSet` answers false for that name. - **The item face** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`, `readMetaItemFace`): when the read finds no item and every package holding the name is disabled, the face answers it as that package's withheld item: `item` undefined, the envelope's `packageId` naming the disabled holder. That is the shape a disabled holder's read had on `main`. Without it, the bare read of such a name carried no package, so the layered view's step 1b and `/published` (which ask the envelope whether a disable withheld the item, on both transports) took it as not withheld. `/layers` then served the disabled package's code layer at the bare address and at `?package=` of any non-holder, and `/published` served its snapshot. The rest suite caught it (`meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`). - **The REST action rung** (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`, `resolveRouteActionByPackage`): a thrown `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` becomes the declaration's `refusal`, answered as the declared `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. Before, it was swallowed as `degraded`. - **Changeset**: `patch` for objectql, metadata-protocol, core, runtime, cli, plugin-security, plugin-email and plugin-sharing, with the BREAKING banner, a before → after line for the library move and one for every moved door answer, each with its first-party count, and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. ### Owed before ACCEPT: the exact-qualifier hunk (ruling (c)) `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` is not touched yet. It waits until #32277 and #32214 have both merged; then this branch merges `origin/main` (no rebase) and adds: - admission over every holder (`includeDisabledPackages: true`), so `?package=DISABLED` reaches the item face and answers its 404; - `resolveMetaItemAddress` falls back to a holding owner over every holder, so the disabled package's namespace path keeps its 404; - pins: `?package=DISABLED` and `/meta/:type/DISABLED_NS/:name` stay 404 on both transports and never name the enabled holder. **Interim, at this head:** with two holders where one is disabled, `?package=DISABLED` and the disabled package's namespace path answer 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` naming the enabled holder, where `main` answers 404. The changeset's "Not moved" line describes the answer after the owed hunk. ## Why The served list (`listItems`) has withheld a disabled package's items since the disable landed, and the item face answers 404 for one. But `packageScopedHoldersOf` read the raw store, so every ADR-0150 D3 door still counted the disabled package as a holder. A name the list showed once was refused 409 naming both packages at the bare read, and a name only a disabled package held was refused naming a package the caller cannot see. The epic ruling 6766102988 names the served list as the right holder set; plugin-sharing's `listedHoldersView` was the one door that already filtered. ## Tests Each new block is a `#32183 — …` describe. All run over the real `SchemaRegistry` except the core catalog's, which uses the file's registry double. - `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`: `flow`, `app` and `page` with two holders, one disabled → the enabled one; a caller outside the closure; the caller's own disabled holding is kept; only-disabled → no holder; `includeDisabledPackages` reads both; re-enable restores the refusal; a disable never promotes a bundle addition. - `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`: the library readers over the live `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, `getApp`, the MCP `agent_prompt` read, a caller outside the closure. - `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` and `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, for every type of the live `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`: two holders with one disabled → 200 with the enabled holder's item; only-disabled → 404 on the bare read, `_env`, `?package=NONHOLDER` and a non-holder's namespace path, never naming the disabled package; the parity pin (the by-name door and the list read agree on holders, through a disable and a re-enable); co-owners of a shareable namespace. - The same two files, for every type: only disabled holders (one, and a name two disabled packages hold) → `/layers` answers 404 at the bare address, `?package=` of a non-holder and `?package=` of an enabled non-holder, serving no layer, and the plain read answers 404 naming neither; CONTROL: enabled, the layered view serves the code layer. The rest file's `beforeEach` wires the engine, so step 1b can ask the registry. - `packages/objectql/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`: the enabled holder's declaration; the rung answers the declared refusal. - `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.test.ts`: a disabled holder's column is not-found and never re-targets; only-disabled is not-found and never reaches the metadata service; `holdsPlatformPermissionSet`. - `packages/objectql/src/engine-picklist.test.ts`: a disabled holder's picklist keeps the field's options, the load audit stays clear, and `resolveItem` answers `undefined`. - The backfills (`activation-ledger-backfill`, `stored-template-package-backfill`, `stored-permission-set-package-backfill`, `stored-declaration-package-backfill`) and the CLI report (`stored-package-references.literal-namespace`, row R20 stays ambiguous naming both). ## Acceptance notes - **A correction to my step-0 readings.** The readings labelled the install door's pending-manifest view (`registry.ts`, `withPendingManifests`) as "the picklist load audit". The load audit reads `picklistReferenceVerdict` on the plain registry. The build keeps that verdict over every holder (see What changes), and the view forwards the option. - **A back door this branch opened, caught and fixed before the PR.** With the served holder set alone, the rest suite went red in `meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` (2 tests): `/published` and `/layers` of a page only the disabled package ships answered 200. A probe showed the same at `?package=` of any non-holder on `/layers`. The step-0 census had not listed the doors that read the bare read's envelope. The item face fix above closes it; ablation A7 below. - **Interim regression** until the owed hunk: see above. - **Changeset wording.** The seat asked for FROM → TO lines. The labels read "Before → after", because the ADR-0087 gate reads an upper-case `FROM → TO` label as a migration prescription beside `no-migration-prescription`. Every moved answer still reads as before → after. - **Not touched:** the install gate (`bareNamePackageHolders`, epic stance 6766291071) and the security catalog's item seam. Limbs 6767831853 and 6767803831 moved to #32292 (ruling (b)). - **#32214's declared item 5** (the email template doors read the raw holder set) is closed by this change once both land, because the filter sits in `packageScopedHoldersOf`. - **Dogfood battery:** owed once, on the final head after the qualifier hunk (narrowing arm). ## Verification All runs are in a worktree under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `dev-32183`), on a shared box, from base `main` at de141e32. Head **340f7cbc**: its last commit only adds a module-top import to one test file (the runtime pin file re-ran 14/14 on it). - **Build:** `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` on 3644f125: 119/119 tasks, exit 0. - **Typecheck** (`pnpm typecheck`, with `check:test-typecheck`): objectql, core, runtime, cli, rest, plugin-security, plugin-email and plugin-sharing on be1f3c3f; metadata-protocol, rest and runtime again on 3644f125. All exit 0. The cli test layer needed a 6 GB heap (it ran out of memory at the default). - **Lint:** root eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over the `src` of the nine touched packages: exit 0. - **Changeset gates:** `check-adr-0087-registration`: `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; `check-changeset-no-major`: no `major` bump. - **Dispatch gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` printed 81 commands. Each ran on 3644f125 with its exit recorded before any pipe. One was red: `check:test-source-alias`, which asked the edited `runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` to load `@objectstack/metadata` at module top; 340f7cbc does that. That gate and four others the edit can move then re-ran on 340f7cbc, all exit 0. `--ran`: "81 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 81 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". - **Dogfood battery:** owed once, on the final head after the qualifier hunk (narrowing arm).
Full suites of the touched packages | package | head | test files | tests | |---|---|---|---| | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` | 3644f125 | 332 passed, 5 skipped (337) | 22658 passed, 29 skipped | | `@objectstack/objectql` | 3644f125 | 584/584 | 12103 passed | | `@objectstack/rest` | 3644f125 | 400/400 | 7730 passed, 332 skipped | | `@objectstack/runtime` | 3644f125 | 577/577 | 9675 passed, 19 skipped | | `@objectstack/core` | be1f3c3f | 144/144 | 3283 passed | | `@objectstack/cli` (`--project unit`; integration declared to CI) | be1f3c3f | 412/412 | 5877 passed | | `@objectstack/plugin-security` | be1f3c3f | 258/258 | 6236 passed, 45 skipped | | `@objectstack/plugin-email` | be1f3c3f | 52/52 | 890 passed | | `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` | be1f3c3f | 74/74 | 1511 passed | On be1f3c3f, objectql and runtime were green and rest had its one red file, `meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` (2 tests). That is the back door in Acceptance notes, fixed by dc50b882. The four suites the fix can move re-ran on 3644f125, as above.
Ablations (seven guards, each through node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs) Each leg that mutates a built package rebuilt it, and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in its `dist/` before the pins ran. Each restore put the file back to its HEAD blob, and the whole tree was clean afterwards. A1–A6 ran on 318f1582 and A7 on dc50b882. | leg | mutation | red | |---|---|---| | A1 | the served filter in `packageScopedHoldersOf` off | objectql 38/205, runtime 42/73, rest 40/54 | | A2 | `includeDisabledPackages` ignored | objectql 3/123, plugin-email 1/4, plugin-security 1/25, plugin-sharing 1/12, cli 1/4 | | A3 | the catalog re-targets a disabled holder's column | core 1/35 | | A4 | the catalog lets an only-disabled name fall to the metadata service | core 2/35 | | A5 | `holdsPlatformPermissionSet` reads an only-disabled name as the environment's | core 1/35 | | A6 | the action rung swallows a thrown refusal as `degraded` | runtime 1/14 | | A7 | the item face's disabled-only arm off | rest 15/75, runtime 13/72 | Baselines before each leg: objectql 205/205 and 123/123, runtime 73/73, rest 54/54, plugin-email 4/4, plugin-security 25/25, plugin-sharing 12/12, cli 4/4, core 35/35; for A7, rest 75/75 and runtime 72/72. Restore legs were green again. For A7, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exited 0.
